Un modelo local es una inteligencia arti: A local model is a small artificial intelligence that runs on your own computer: it is free, needs no internet or key, and nothing you type leaves your machine. It answers more slowly and with less flair than the online services, and the older your computer, the longer it takes. The game downloads two things to the folder data, local AI: the program called dot c p p, which is open source, and the model you choose. While AI mode uses it, the game starts it when it opens and always closes it on exit: nothing is ever left running.
